description: Move a folder, with everything inside it, under another parent or back to the top level. The API refuses a move into the folder itself or one of its subfolders, or next to a folder of the same name.

folder.description: The folder identifier (the id field of list_folders)

parent.description: Destination parent folder identifier; "root", or leaving it out, means the top level

name: move_folder
title: Move a folder
